cd /app && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import subprocess, json, time, random
rng=random.Random(3)
def fmt(addr,length=None):
    g=[(addr>>(112-16*i))&0xffff for i in range(8)]
    bs=-1;bl=0;i=0
    while i<8:
        if g[i]==0:
            j=i
            while j<8 and g[j]==0: j+=1
            r=j-i
            if r>=2 and r>bl: bl=r;bs=i
            i=j
        else: i+=1
    if bs>=0: s=':'.join('%x'%x for x in g[:bs])+'::'+':'.join('%x'%x for x in g[bs+bl:])
    else: s=':'.join('%x'%x for x in g)
    if length is not None: s+='/%d'%length
    return s
FULL=(1<<128)-1
def trunc(v,b): return v & (FULL^((1<<(128-b))-1)) if 0<b<128 else (0 if b<=0 else v)
reqs=[]
for i in range(200):
    fib=[];seen=set()
    for _ in range(41):
        l=rng.randint(1,128); v=trunc(rng.getrandbits(128),l)
        if (v,l) in seen: continue
        seen.add((v,l)); fib.append((v,l,rng.randint(0,65535)))
    S=rng.randint(4,16)
    reqs.append({"op":"compile","fib":[{"prefix":fmt(v,l),"hop":h} for v,l,h in fib],"capacities":[10**6]*S,"max_stride":32})
data="\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+"\n"
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(["/app/submit/run"],input=data.encode(),capture_output=True,timeout=170)
print("rc",p.returncode,"n",len(p.stdout.splitlines()),"time",round(time.time()-t,2))
st=set(json.loads(x)["status"] for x in p.stdout.splitlines())
print("statuses",st)
PYEOF
